Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:10:1.english: We do not say, etc. - For the prohibition of [taking a false] oath is more severe to people than the prohibition of robbery.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:11:1.english: He is evading him - And [therefore] he is not suspected with regard to money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:11:2.english: In accordance with Rabba - As he said above: "Why did the Torah say, etc.?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:1.hebrew: תדע - דלאו בגזלן חשדינן ליה, אלא באשתמוטי בעלמא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:1.english: Know [that this is so] - That we do not suspect him of being a robber, but rather of merely putting [his creditor] off.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:2.hebrew: דאמר רב אידי בר אבין הכופר במלוה - שבאו עדים והחזיקוהו בכפרן, שהעידוהו שהוא חייב לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:2.english: For Rav Idi bar Avin said: One who denies a loan - [In a case] where witnesses came and established him as a denier, by testifying that he owes him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:3.hebrew: כשר לעדות - אלמא לאו דעתיה למגזליה, דנימא ״אל תשת עד חמס״, אלא לאשתמוטי עביד:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:3.english: [He is] fit to bear witness - Evidently, it is not his intention to rob him, that we should say: "Do not set [your hand with the wicked to be] a malicious witness"; rather, he did [so] to evade [his creditor].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:4.hebrew: בפקדון פסול לעדות - דמאי אשתמוטי איכא? הרי לא ניתן להוצאה, ובעין הוא, ואם אבד, יטעון שאבד ויפטר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:12:4.english: [One who denies] a deposit is disqualified from [giving] testimony - For what evasion is there [here]? Behold, it was not given to be spent, and it is intact; and if it was lost, let him claim that it was lost and be exempt.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:13:1.hebrew: ולימא מיגו דחשיד אממונא - דההוא דאמר לא היו דברים מעולם, כופר בפקדון הוא, וליכא למימר משתמיט:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:13:1.english: And let us say: Since he is suspect regarding money - For that one who says, "These things never occurred," is one who denies a deposit, and it cannot be said [that] he is [merely] evading [the claimant].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:13:2.hebrew: חשיד נמי אשבועה דידה - דבשלמא אשבועת שומרין, דההוא דקטעין נאנסה, דחייביה רחמנא שבועה, איכא למימר דלא חשיד אממונא, אלא שמא פשע בשמירתה וחייב לשלם אונסיה, וסבר: עד דהוי לי זוזי ופרענא ליה. אלא ההיא דכפירה, הא ודאי כופר בפקדון הוא ומשקר, והיכי משבעינן ליה עלה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:13:2.english: He is also suspected with regard to its oath - For granted, regarding the bailees' oath, where one claims that [the deposit] was lost to an unavoidable accident, in which the Merciful One obligated him [to take] an oath, it can be said that he is not suspected of financial dishonesty; rather, perhaps he was negligent in guarding it and is liable to pay for its mishap, and he thinks: "[I will stall] until I have money, and then I will pay him." However, that [case] of denial — behold, he is definitely denying [having received] the deposit and lying, so how can we administer an oath to him regarding it?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:14:1.hebrew: התם נמי אשתמוטי משתמיט - שאבדה ממנו, וסבר: משכחנא לגנב כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:14:1.english: There too, he is merely evading - [In a case] where it was lost from him, and he thought: "I will find the thief, etc."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:15:1.hebrew: אי הכי - בפקדון הוא ומשקר, והיכי משבעינן ליה עלה? התם נמי אשתמוטי משתמיט, שאבדה ממנו, וסבר: משכחנא לגנב כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:15:1.english: If so - [That is: If regarding the objection that] in [the case of] a deposit he is lying, and how do we administer an oath to him regarding it, [the answer is that] there too he is merely evading, as it was lost from him and he thought: "I will find the thief, etc."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:15:2.english: If so - [That] regarding a deposit, it can be said that he is stalling.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:15:3.english: That I will search - I will search.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:16:1.english: This is the correct reading: "That at that time it was with him" - And one does not read: "At that time that he swore."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:17:1.hebrew: דאמר רב הונא - לקמן בהמפקיד, גבי שילם ולא רצה לישבע, אמר רב הונא: אם בא לשלם, משביעין אותו שבועה שאינה ברשותו, חיישינן שמא עיניו נתן בה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:17:1.english: That which Rav Huna said - Below, in [chapter] HaMafkid, regarding "he paid and did not wish to take an oath," Rav Huna said: If he comes to pay, we administer an oath to him that it is not in his possession, [for] we suspect lest he set his eyes upon it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:18:1.hebrew: התם - לא חשיד אממונא, דמורי היתירא למימר: דמי בעינא למיתב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:18:1.english: There - He is not suspected of monetary [dishonesty], because he rationalizes [that it is permitted], saying: "I intend to pay [its] monetary value."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:19:1.hebrew: הא קא עבר בלא תחמוד - מה לי חשוד על לא תחמוד, מה לי חשוד על לא תגזול? נימא: מיגו דחשיד עליה, חשיד אשבועתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:19:1.english: Behold, he violates "You shall not covet" - What difference is there to me [whether he is] suspected of [violating] "You shall not covet", [or] what difference is there to me [whether he is] suspected of [violating] "You shall not rob"? Let us say: Since he is suspected of it, he is [also] suspected of [taking a false] oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:1:1.hebrew: ותקנתא - דכשכנגדו ישבע ויטול, דהויא נמי תקנתא, דמן התורה מי שעליו לשלם הוא ישבע ויפטר מן התשלומין, ואין נשבע ונוטל מן התורה, ואותן המנויין בשבועות (דף מד:) תקנת חכמים הן. ולשבועה דאורייתא עבוד רבנן תקנתא, אבל תקנתא לתקנתא לא עבדינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:1:1.english: And an ordinance - That his opponent swears and collects is also an ordinance; for by Torah law, the one who is liable to pay is the one who swears and is exempt from payment, and no one swears and collects by Torah law, and those [cases] enumerated in Shevuot (44b) are a rabbinic ordinance. And for a Torah oath the Rabbis instituted an ordinance, but we do not institute an ordinance upon an ordinance.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:2:1.hebrew: ותיפוק ליה דהוה ליה רועה - אדאביי קא מתמה, דקשיא ליה: והא גזלן הוא, ותיפוק ליה דבלאו הך גזילה פסול לשבועה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:2:1.english: And let him derive [it from the fact] that he is a shepherd - [The Gemara] wonders at Abaye, who raised the difficulty: "Isn't he a robber?" But let him derive that [even] without this robbery, he is disqualified from [taking] an oath.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:2:2.english: For Rav Yehuda said: An ordinary shepherd - Even if testimony was not given against him that he stole.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:2:3.hebrew: פסול - לעדות, דסתמיה גזלן הוא, שמרעה בהמותיו בשדות של אחרים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:2:3.english: Disqualified - From [giving] testimony, for ordinarily he is a robber, as he pastures his animals in the fields of others.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:3:1.hebrew: דידיה - רועה בהמות שלו פסול, דבשביל הנאתו רועה אותן בשדות אחרות. אבל רועה בהמות העיר בשכר, בשביל הנאת אחרים אינו חוטא להרעות, עד שיגיע למרעה המופקר לכל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:3:1.english: His own - One who herds his own animals is disqualified, because for his own benefit he grazes them in others' fields. However, one who herds the animals of the town for wages, for the benefit of others he will not sin by letting [them] graze [in others' fields; rather, he waits] until he reaches pasture that is open to all.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:3:2.hebrew: דאי לא תימא הכי - דלא אמרינן על רועה בהמות דעלמא שהוא גזלן, אנן חיותא לרועה היכי מסרינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:3:2.english: For if you do not say so - That we do not say about a shepherd of other people's animals that he is a robber, [then] how do we hand over animals to a shepherd?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:4:1.hebrew: על דאית ליה משתבע או על דלית ליה משתבע - הבא לישבע וליטול חציה, צריך הוא לישבע שיש לו בה חציה, או לישבע שאין לו בה פחות מחציה? שמא אין לו בה כלום, וכי משתבע שאין לו בה פחות מחציה, באמת הוא נשבע, שהרי אין לו כלום. דבשלמא אם היה לו בה שליש או רביע, והוא נשבע שאין לו בה פחות מחציה, נשבע בשקר, שהרי יש לו בה שליש שהוא פחות מחציה, ואין לו בה חציה; אבל כשאין לו בה כלום, נשבע הוא באמת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:4:1.english: Does he take an oath concerning what he has, or concerning what he does not have - Must one who comes to take an oath and take half of it swear that he has half of it, or swear that he does not have less than half of it? [If the latter, there is a concern] lest he has nothing in it at all, and when he swears that he does not have less than half of it, he is swearing truthfully, since he has nothing. For granted, if he had a third or a fourth in it and he swore that he does not have less than half of it, he would be swearing falsely, as he has a third in it, which is less than half, and he does not have half of it; but when he has nothing in it at all, he is swearing truthfully.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:4:2.hebrew: שבועה שיש לי בה - ואם תאמרו: שמא שליש או רביע? שבועה שאין לי חלק בה פחות מחציה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:4:2.english: An oath that I have [a share] in it - And if you say, perhaps [he has only] a third or a quarter? [Therefore, he must also say:] “[I take] an oath that I do not have a share in it of less than half of it.”

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:5:1.hebrew: מי יהבינן ליה כולה - הרי חבירו תופס בה, ואם ישביעוהו על כולה, הרי לעז לב"ד, מאחר שכולה שלו, והם אמרו יחלוקו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:5:1.english: Would we give him all of it - Behold, his fellow is holding onto it, and if they administer an oath to him regarding all of it, this would bring discredit upon the court, since all of it is his, and [yet] they said: "Let them divide it."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:6:1.hebrew: מרע ליה לדיבוריה - דאמר ברישא כולה שלי, והשתא אמר בהדיא חציה שלי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:6:1.english: He undermines his statement - For initially he said, "All of it is mine," and now he is explicitly saying, "Half of it is mine."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:7:1.english: For he says: All of it is mine - This is the resolution.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:7:2.hebrew: ולדבריכם - שאין אתם מאמינים לי בכולה, שבועה שיש לי בה, ואין לי בה פחות מחציה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:7:2.english: And according to your words - Since you do not believe me regarding all of it, [I take an] oath that I have [a share] in it, and I do not have in it less than half of it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:9:1.hebrew: ונימא מגו דחשיד אממונא חשיד כו' - אדרבי יוחנן פריך, דאמר חשדוהו רבנן שמא ילך ותוקף בטליתו של חבירו ואומר ״שלי הוא״. אם חשוד הוא בכך, חשוד הוא נמי לישבע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 5b:9:1.english: And let us say: Since he is suspected regarding money, he is suspected, etc. - [The Gemara] objects to [the statement of] Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said that the Rabbis suspected him lest he go and seize his fellow's garment and say: "It is mine." If he is suspected of this, he should also be suspected of taking an oath [falsely].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:10:1.hebrew: דחשיד אממונא לא חשיד אשבועתא - נראה דהיינו טעמא, משום דשבועה חמורה, כדאיתא ביומא (דף פו.) ובשבועות (דף לט.), שהעולם נזדעזע על ״לא תשא״. וא"ת: א"כ, אמאי גזלן פסול לשבועה, דאמר ״שכנגדו נשבע ונוטל״? וי"ל, דגזלן לא פסול לשבועה אלא מדרבנן, ולעדות הוא דפסול מדאורייתא, משום ״אל תשת רשע עד״. וי"מ בשם ה"ר יהודה חסיד: הא דחשיד אממונא כשר לשבועה — משום דשמא ע"י שבועה יפרוש מגזל; אבל גזלן ודאי, כמו שמממון אינו פורש, ה"ה משבועה. ולא קשה מההוא רעיא דאסהידו ביה דאכל מינייהו: אמאי פסול, דבהנך תרי דאכל צריך לשלם, ומהשאר יפרוש על ידי שבועה? דמה שהוא משלם על ידי עדים אין זה השבה מעליא, דעל כרחו משלם. והיינו טעמא דכופר בפקדון פסול לעדות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:10:1.english: One who is suspect regarding money is not suspect regarding an oath - It appears that this is the reason: because an oath is severe, as it is stated in Yoma (folio 86a) and in Shevuot (folio 39a), that the world trembled at [the commandment]: "You shall not take [the name of the Lord your God in vain]" (Exodus 20:7). And if you say: If so, why is a robber disqualified from [taking] an oath, as [the Mishna] states: His opponent swears and takes [payment]? And one can say: A robber is disqualified from [taking] an oath only by rabbinic decree, and it is [only] for testimony that he is disqualified by Torah law, because [of the verse]: "Do not place a wicked person as a witness" (Exodus 23:1). And some explain in the name of Rabbi Judah the Pious: That which [one who is] suspect regarding money is eligible to [take] an oath is because perhaps by means of an oath he will withdraw from theft; but a confirmed robber, just as he does not withdraw from [stealing] money, the same applies to an oath [he will not withdraw from swearing falsely]. And it is not difficult from that shepherd about whom [witnesses] testified that he ate [two animals] from them: Why was he disqualified [from taking an oath regarding the rest], seeing that regarding those two that he ate he must pay, and from the rest he would withdraw by means of an oath? [This is not difficult,] for that which he pays on account of witnesses is not considered a proper restitution, as he pays against his will. And this is the reason why one who denies a deposit is disqualified from [giving] testimony.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:16:1.hebrew: ההיא שעתא דאיתיה בביתיה - ל"ג דאשתבע, דאי איכא סהדי דנשבע לשקר, במלוה נמי פסול. וכן משמע בהגוזל קמא (ב"ק דף קז:), דמיירי בלא שבועה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:16:1.english: At that time it was in his house - We do not read "that he swore," for if there are witnesses that he swore falsely, he would be disqualified in [the case of] a loan as well. And so it is implied in HaGozel Kama (Bava Kamma 107b), that it is dealing with [a case] without an oath.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:1:1.hebrew: ותקנתא לתקנתא - ומתוך שאינו יכול לישבע משלם, לא שייך הכא, כדפרישית:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:1:1.english: And an enactment upon an enactment - And [the principle that] "since he is unable to swear, he must pay" does not apply here, as I explained.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:20:1.hebrew: בלא דמי משמע להו - וא"ת: תיפוק ליה מלא תגזול? וי"ל: לעבור עליו בשני לאוין. וא"ת: והא כי יהיב דמי נמי חמסן הוה, כדמוכח שלהי הכונס (בבא קמא דף סב.), ושוחמסן פסול לעדות, כדכתיב: "אל תשת ידך עם רשע להיות עד חמס", והפסול לעדות פסול לשבועה, דכל הנהו דחשיב בפסולי עדות בפרק זה בורר (סנהדרין דף כה: ושם) פוסל להו לשבועה בפרק כל הנשבעין (שבועות דף מה.)? וי"ל: דחמסן לא פסול לעדות אלא מדרבנן, מדתני בפרק זה בורר: "הוסיפו עליהם החמסנין", ולא פריך: "חמסן דאורייתא הוא?", כדפריך אגזלן; וחמסן דקרא — דלא יהיב דמי; ושלהי הגוזל (ב"ק דף קיט.) דמייתי קרא דמחמס בני יהודה, אפי' אי יהיב דמי, אסמכתא בעלמא הוא. ואע"ג דהוסיפו עליהם החמסנין לפסול לעדות, וה"ה שפסול לשבועה — היינו חמסן שחצוף לחטוף מיד ליד בידיעת הבעלים; אבל הכא לא חציף, אלא מעלים חמסנותו ואמר שנאבדה לו, לא פסיל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:20:1.english: Without [paying] money, it implies to them - And if you say: Let it be derived from [the prohibition of] "You shall not rob" [Leviticus 19:13]? And one can answer: [Rav Aḥa asked from "You shall not covet" in order to show that he would] transgress two negative commandments regarding it. And if you say: But even when he gives money, he is a chamsan [one who takes by force with payment], as is proven at the end of [the chapter] HaKones (Bava Kamma 62a); and that a chamsan is disqualified from giving testimony, as it is written: "Do not place your hand with a wicked person to be an unfair witness [eid chamas]" (Exodus 23:1); and one who is disqualified from giving testimony is disqualified from taking an oath, for all those whom [the Mishnah] enumerates among those disqualified from giving testimony in chapter Zeh Borer (Sanhedrin 25b and ibid.), it disqualifies from taking an oath in chapter Kol HaNishba'in (Shevuot 45a)? And one can answer: A chamsan is disqualified from giving testimony only by rabbinic law. For it is taught in chapter Zeh Borer: "They added the chamsanim to them," and [the Gemara] does not challenge: "Isn't a chamsan [disqualified] by Torah law?" as it challenges regarding a robber [gazlan]. And the chamsan of Scripture is one who does not give money. And [the passage at] the end of HaGozel (Bava Kamma 119a) which cites the verse: "From the violence [me-chamas] of the children of Judah" (Joel 4:19) — even if he gives money, it is merely an asmakhta [biblical allusion]. And even though they added the chamsanim to disqualify [them] from giving testimony — and the same applies, that [such a one] is disqualified from taking an oath — that is specifically a chamsan who is brazen [enough] to snatch [the item] from hand to hand with the knowledge of the owner. But here, he is not brazen, but rather conceals his forceful taking and says that it was lost from him; [therefore] he is not disqualified.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:4:1.hebrew: על דאית ליה משתבע כו' - ואע"ג דעל דעת ב"ד משביעין אותו, מ"מ לא הו"ל לתקן שבועה בלשון דלא משתמע שחציה שלו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:4:1.english: Does he take an oath with regard to that which he has, etc. - And even though they administer an oath to him according to the intent of the court, nevertheless, [the Sages] should not have instituted an oath in language that does not imply that half of it is his.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:5:1.hebrew: ונימא שבועה שכולה שלי - לרבנן דבן ננס פריך, דלא חיישי לשבועת שוא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:5:1.english: And let him say: "An oath that all of it is mine" - [The Gemara] asks according to the Rabbis [who dispute] Ben Nannas, who are not concerned about an oath taken in vain.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:7:1.hebrew: כולה שלי ולדבריכם כו' - אף על גב דקאמר כולה שלי, לא משתבע שחציה שלו, שמרע לדיבוריה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 5b:7:1.english: All of it is mine, and according to your words, etc. - Even though he says "all of it is mine," he does not swear that half of it is his, because that would compromise his statement.
